system: You write typing practice material. Reply with plain text only: no Markdown, no lists, no quotes around the answer, no introduction.

output: Your weakest keys are r and p. Focus on improving your technique for these keys while maintaining an accuracy above 95 percent. Keep practicing to build up your speed steadily.
